title: Not at all accurate for road conditions
body: OnTheWayApp gets one thing right: temperature forecasts and the “chain up / carry chains” zones were accurate. That’s it. Everything else has been unreliable. Multiple times on high-mileage trips this past week, the app showed clear road conditions and clear weather when that was absolutely not the case. It repeatedly failed to flag the stuff that actually matters for travel—slick and icy roads, fog, snowy conditions, and other hazards you need to know about before you commit to a route. If you’re using this to make real trip decisions, don’t. Verify conditions through official state road and weather sites instead. This app has failed every single time I’ve needed it.

Makes it very time consuming to plan the route. Also keeps you from experimenting like heading to Albuquerque as a stop and then having the trip to adjust to the southern route along interstate 10 to weigh the trade off of extra miles to Augusta vs warmer temperatures and better road conditions since this is a motorcycle trip - can’t do it without making Albuquerque my first destination and then going stop by stop to Augusta. 2) Once you set a trip and departure time the weather along the way stays the same even if you modify the departure time, you can’t just change the departure time and watch the weather along the way respond to see the optimum departure time. title: DELIVERS
body: I downloaded this app for help determining when was best to take my road trip at a time inclement weather was expected. I found it invaluable and can confidently say, based on my personal though limited experience, that this app absolutely delivered on its intended purpose: For my trip, WOTW solved the "when is the best time to leave for my roadtrip (when inclement weather is expected)" question any frequent road tripper has faced. It answers this question in a manner unlike anything I've experienced before. No more looking at predictions across multiple cities and basically taking wild guesses on the best time to depart. How does it do this so marvelously? The "time leaving" slider. That's how. This slider is he best road trip weather planning tool I've experienced. It does exactly what you'd hope. Upon entering a destination/departure time, a slider appears below your route map. You can then scroll forward and even backward in time while weather conditions on your route map change dynamically based on current expectations. Perfect. Integration with Apple CarPlay is icing on the cake. I'm talking it's RIGHT THERE on your car's screen AS YOU DRIVE. It overlays above Apple Maps somehow. I wasn't able to explore all the amazing capabilities but saw enough to highly recommend Weather On the Way to any frequent road tripper. Or even - well, just anyone who wants weather from here to wherever "there" is, now or whenever, no matter how near or far. Highly recommended.

We found it to be off anywhere between 30 to 45 minutes an hour. This was not including the time that we allotted for stops for gas, food, etc. One thing I did love about the app was that we could get a guideline of if we left a certain time a certain day, guesstimate timeframe of arrival and also very good to know ahead of time if there was any type of weather to look out for. Feature that lacking that it did not offer was step-by-step directions as this feature would have been great to have, then we would not have to run a Google map on the side. The other thing that I loved about the app was that we could alter the directions by adding a stop into another city or state it would allow us to alter the direction just a bit to give us a better direct route Tricking the system working around the map to make a better route and work around weather. All in all, I would recommend this app if you don’t need the step-by-step directions, but I feel I would be able to give this application a five star if they would add this feature make it seamless for somebody traveling I would still use it in the near future when I take another trip It’s very cost-effective. Nicely done!

title: Fantastic app and fantastic help
body: I purchased this app last night after stumbling across it when I was looking for something - anything - that would help me plot weather across my route simply. This app did it beautifully. The interface is great, simple, and informative. I also had what I thought was a glitch (but was not) when I tried to open it on a second device. It turned out that I simply had to wait for that device to sync with my App Store/Apple ID so that the purchase would be recognized. In the interim, I emailed the developer and got a response within minutes. How great is that? I assume the forecast information is accurate since I have not actually traveled as route yet (though, from what I’ve seen as it relates to other weather forecast, the temperatures and cloud cover appear to be accurate) but, from all that I have seen so far, this app is fantastic. If you are a traveler, buy it!
